Brother Khatul

Overview

Brother Khatul leads the brotherhood of the Last Shelter, calling himself first among equals. He initially tests Zak by demanding the Emperor’s Signet Ring, wary of spies who could betray the refuge. Once Zak is accepted, Khatul offers a home and support but insists that personal revenge must not expose the entire brotherhood. He arranges training with Brother Blind and asks Brother Faceless to help Zak reach the Portal. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Acceptance into the Last Shelter

Beyond the caves, Brother Blacksmith finds Zak and vouches for him before Brother Khatul. The brotherhood’s leader fears imperial spies and requires the Emperor’s Signet Ring, taken from a cyclops who killed its courier. Possessing such an object compromises the newcomer with the authorities and makes the test more than a feat of strength. After Zak returns, Khatul accepts him as Brother Blondie and offers the refuge as a new home. Zak explains his promise to find At-Zako and return to Gipath. Khatul respects that purpose and asks those who can help to support him; Brother Blind can teach him greater dexterity. [1, 2, 4]

Sahilia’s cache and the Joon collector

Sahilia supplies the next lead through her own theft. Antiquities she stole from Baluddin remain hidden near the city, and Zak recovers them to arrange a meeting. Khatul and Brother Blacksmith help choose the secluded trading place, keeping strangers away from the Shelter. Baluddin admits recognising At-Zako as a living Joon and wanting to keep him in his own house. Imperial scholars took the young man away. Later, Taivo summoned the collector to identify those scholars’ mutilated bodies. The missing youth’s trail now leads to the necromancers rather than a living prisoner whom Zak can simply rescue. [6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]

Brother Faceless and the return to Gipath

Khatul asks Brother Faceless to help Zak reach the guarded portal. Faceless arranges a cave meeting and explains the keys and stone controls. He then reveals himself as Erfar: born on Suslanger, he went to Gipath seeking the meteorite and manipulated the villagers into searching for it. His earlier plots were attempts to remove Zak, who disrupted that scheme. The reunion is another trap, with guards waiting outside the cave. Zak survives the confrontation and forces a route through the portal’s defences. Activating its two controls finally returns him to Tka-Rik with the amulet fragments. [13, 5, 14, 15, 16]
